//: Sections are persistent document nodes: creation adds simultaneous clipping planes, deleting a picked frame removes only that node, and double-clicking reopens that node's editor without another plane pick.

(async () => { const view = globalThis.activeView; const panel = globalThis.app.mainWindow.querySelector('command-context'); const flip = panel.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]'); if (!flip) throw new Error('flip option is missing'); const offsetBeforeFlip = view.sectionPlane.origin.x; const normalBeforeFlip = view.sectionPlane.normal; flip.click(); if (!view.sectionPlane.normal.isEqualTo(normalBeforeFlip.reverse())) throw new Error('flip did not reverse the normal'); if (Math.abs(view.sectionPlane.origin.x - offsetBeforeFlip) > 1e-6) throw new Error('flip moved the plane'); view.update(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100)); return true; })()

(() => { const view = globalThis.activeView; globalThis.__sectionCountBeforeCreate = globalThis.__sectionNodes().length; globalThis.__firstSectionNode = globalThis.__sectionNodes()[0]; globalThis.__sectionPlaneBeforeDelete = globalThis.__firstSectionNode.plane; const button = Array.from(view.dom.querySelectorAll('svg')).find((svg) => svg.querySelector('use')?.getAttributeNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink', 'href') === '#icon-sectionView'); if (!button) throw new Error('viewport section button is missing'); button.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true })); return true; })()

(async () => { const view = globalThis.activeView; view.update(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200)); globalThis.__updateSectionFrameClick = () => { const visual = view.document.visual.context.visualShapes.getObjectByName('sectionPlane'); if (!visual) throw new Error('section frame visual is missing'); const frame = visual.wholeVisual()[0]; const positions = frame.geometry.attributes.instanceStart; if (!frame.visible || positions.count !== 4) throw new Error('section frame is not a visible rectangle'); const start = view.camera.position.clone().fromBufferAttribute(positions, 0); const end = view.camera.position.clone().fromBufferAttribute(positions, 1); const point = view.worldToScreen(start.clone().add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5)); const rect = view.dom.getBoundingClientRect(); globalThis.__sectionFrameClick = { x: rect.left + point.x, y: rect.top + point.y }; }; globalThis.__updateSectionFrameClick(); return true; })()

(() => { const view = globalThis.activeView; const nodes = globalThis.__sectionNodes(); if (nodes.length !== globalThis.__sectionCountBeforeCreate || nodes[0] === globalThis.__firstSectionNode) throw new Error('deleting one section did not preserve the others'); if (view.sectionPlanes.length !== globalThis.__sectionCountBeforeCreate || view.renderer.clippingPlanes.length !== globalThis.__sectionCountBeforeCreate) throw new Error('deleting one section did not preserve the other clipping planes'); if (view.document.visual.context.getVisual(globalThis.__firstSectionNode)) throw new Error('deleting the selected section left its frame visual behind'); const saved = JSON.stringify(view.document.serialize()); if (!saved.includes('SectionPlaneNode') || !saved.includes(nodes[0].id) || !saved.includes('Views')) throw new Error('the remaining section is not saved under Views in the document'); globalThis.__lastSectionNode = nodes[0]; globalThis.__sectionPlaneBeforeDelete = nodes[0].plane; return true; })()

(async () => { const view = globalThis.activeView; view.update(); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 200)); globalThis.__updateSectionFrameClick(); const point = globalThis.__sectionFrameClick; view.dom.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('dblclick', { bubbles: true, clientX: point.x, clientY: point.y })); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 150)); if (!globalThis.app.executingCommand) throw new Error('double-clicking the section frame did not open its editor'); if (view.document.visual.eventHandler === view.document.visual.defaultEventHandler) throw new Error('double-clicking the section frame did not install its edit handles'); if (view.document.visual.context.tempShapes.children.length !== 5) throw new Error('double-clicking asked for a new plane instead of editing the retained section'); if (globalThis.__lastSectionNode.plane !== globalThis.__sectionPlaneBeforeDelete) throw new Error('double-clicking changed the retained plane before an edit'); return true; })()

(() => { const view = globalThis.activeView; const frame = view.document.visual.context.visualShapes.getObjectByName('sectionPlane').wholeVisual()[0]; const positions = frame.geometry.attributes.instanceStart; const rect = view.dom.getBoundingClientRect(); for (let segment = 0; segment < 4; segment++) { const start = view.camera.position.clone().fromBufferAttribute(positions, segment * 2); const end = view.camera.position.clone().fromBufferAttribute(positions, segment * 2 + 1); for (const t of [0.5, 0.25, 0.75]) { const screen = view.worldToScreen(start.clone().lerp(end, t)); const point = { x: rect.left + screen.x, y: rect.top + screen.y }; if (!Number.isFinite(point.x) || !Number.isFinite(point.y)) continue; const target = document.elementFromPoint(point.x, point.y); if (target && view.dom.contains(target) && !target.closest('command-context')) { globalThis.__sectionFrameClick = point; return true; } } } throw new Error('no section frame edge is clickable outside the editor panel'); })()
